purpose: Teach: 有利/他者/ロンドン/清水/余りに/不便/スケール/優位

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の、本気で、絶対、状況、絶対、有利、絶対、だよね
lines.en: Riku, your situation's seriously working in your favor, isn't it.
lines.style: Bright, teasing energy. Quick, almost conspiratorial rhythm. Leans forward. The tone of someone enjoying a private joke with you.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お前、本気で、絶対、他者、絶対、への、絶対、配慮、絶対、すごいよな、桜
lines.en: Yeah. You know, the way you actually care about what other people think—it's seriously impressive, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine warmth beneath the surface. Slower than her pace. Holds the compliment steady without making it weird. Direct eye contact, no deflection.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 修学旅行で、本気で、絶対、ロンドン、絶対、行きたいよね、リク
lines.en: The school trip went to London, didn't it? That's what you wanted, right Riku.
lines.style: Eager, almost wistful. Picks up tempo slightly. The dream still bright in her voice, even if it's tinged with longing for something that didn't happen.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 修学旅行で、本気で、絶対、清水、絶対、寺、絶対、行ったぜ、桜
lines.en: Our school trip actually went to Kiyomizu Temple, remember? That's what we did.
lines.style: Gentle reminder, no edge. Grounded, reflective. Slower cadence, like he's settling into the memory. Soft acceptance underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 試験勉強、本気で、絶対、余りに、絶対、辛いよね、リク
lines.en: Studying for these tests is killing me, honestly. You know how brutal it is.
lines.style: Wry, exhausted humor. A little edge underneath, but wrapped in the tone of someone venting to someone who gets it. Quick, slightly breathless.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の家、本気で、絶対、駅から、絶対、不便、絶対、だよな、桜
lines.en: Your house is kind of a trek from the station, isn't it. Pretty inconvenient location.
lines.style: Mild, observational. Not complaining—just stating fact. Steady, almost curious tone. The way you'd mention something you'd noticed but never said out loud before.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭、本気で、絶対、スケール、絶対、大きくなったよね、リク
lines.en: The cultural festival this year got so much bigger, didn't it. The scale was huge.
lines.style: Animated, impressed. Picks up energy as the thought develops. Bright recognition. A little bubble of pride in her voice that she's not hiding.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のチーム、本気で、絶対、試合で、絶対、優位、絶対、だぜ、桜
lines.en: Your team's got a real advantage going into that match, seriously. You've got this.
lines.style: Solid confidence, delivered close. Warm without being soft. The tone of someone backing their friend. Steady eye contact, shoulders relaxed.
